errors.evidence: The machine-generated description omits the explicit purpose of Figure A (промяната на средни леглодни през годините) and Figure B (структурният ефект върху средни леглодни като процентно изменение през годините).
The reference description states the value for 2008 in Figure B is approximately 1.6%, but the machine-generated description reports it as around 1.5%.
The reference description states the value for 2012 in Figure B is below 0.6%, but the machine-generated description reports it as around 0.9%.
The reference description states the value for 2013 in Figure B is 0.3%, but the machine-generated description reports it as around 0.7–0.8%.
The reference description states the value for 2021 in Figure B is almost 2.8%, but the machine-generated description reports it as around 2.3%.
The machine-generated description for Figure B omits the full y-axis range (0% to over 2%) and tick intervals (every 0.5%).
The machine-generated description for Figure B does not mention the lowest point in 2013 (0.3%), which is explicitly highlighted in the reference.
The machine-generated description uses an ellipsis ("Средни … (дни)") instead of the full axis label "Средни леглодни (дни)", which is less precise.
The machine-generated description uses an ellipsis ("Структурен ефект върху средни … (%)") instead of the full axis label "Структурен ефект върху средни леглодни (%)", which is less precise.
The reference description states the value for 2012 in Figure A is approximately 265, but the machine-generated description reports it as around 266.
The reference description does not specify a value for 2013 in Figure A, but the machine-generated description reports it as around 271, which is slightly higher than the visible trend.
The machine-generated description for Figure A omits the exact y-axis tick intervals (every 20 days), though it mentions approximate labels.
